name: Elaine Floyd
source:
[url=/c166405]Donna[/url]'s mother, a gentle and easygoing woman.
A country mother who loves her husband and daughter more than anything.
She's usually absent-minded, but she's a woman who takes decisive action when her family is in trouble.

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/tea/teaparty.htm]official website[/url]]
